en.t: I had no conception of happiness at all.

units.source_text: 我自己仿佛被某种秩序所抛弃，

en.t: It was as though I myself had been abandoned by some kind of order,

units.source_text: 独自离了群，拖着疲惫的脚步，漫步在荒凉的地方。

en.t: left alone outside the group, dragging my weary feet as I wandered through a desolate place.

units.source_text: 欲望在我心中只露出不悦的脊背，在抱膝蹲着。

en.t: Desire, inside my heart, merely showed its displeased back and crouched there hugging its knees.
